title: PFM Settings
description: One row per setting the app and flows read (wing name for the subtitle, PFM mailbox, defaults). Values are entered on the gov device, never in the repo.

fields.ref: What the setting does and who reads it

seed.Title: CoordinationSuspenseBusinessDays
seed.SettingNotes: Business days a coordinator gets to respond (DAFMAN 90-161 5.2). Flows count weekdays only; holidays not excluded.

seed.Title: GuardReserveApplicabilityCalendarDays
seed.SettingNotes: Calendar days for Guard Applicability and Reserve Applicability coordinators below MAJCOM level (DAFMAN 90-161 5.2.2).
